caption: A pair of reading glasses is slid across a menu, and the text seen through the lenses appears slightly larger than the text around the frames.

sa.check: A pair of reading glasses is slid across a menu.
The text seen through the lenses appears larger than the text around the frames.

pc.expect: The change happens only in the area seen through the lenses and moves with the glasses.
pc.fail: Text outside the frames is enlarged; or text under the lenses is unchanged; or the enlarged patch stays put while the glasses slide.

pc.expect: The menu itself does not change; the enlarged text is the same text.
pc.fail: The text under the lenses is different; or the menu changes; or the enlarged text is mirrored.

pc.expect: The menu stays put and the glasses move only as pushed.
pc.fail: The menu slides; or the glasses move by themselves; or the image shifts with the glasses still.
They bend; or ripple; or go opaque.

pc.expect: One pair of glasses and one menu.
pc.fail: The glasses duplicate; or the menu vanishes; or the hand passes through the glasses.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The menu and the frames stay the same.
pc.fail: The menu changes colour; or the frames change; or the table changes.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
